Name: Vinilla's Album Catalogue
Author: VinillaBean
Description:
[size=4][b]What this mod is[/b][/size]
A catalogue that collects all of your[b][u] currently installed[/u][/b] Content Patcher album mods made by me in one place. These include:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16529]Beatles Albums[/url]﻿[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25592]Sparks Albums[/url]﻿[/*]
[/list]Needs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url] to function. You can buy the catalogue from Robin for 1,000G and then place it indoors to get all of the album paintings for free.

[size=4][b]What this mod is NOT[/b][/size]
A mega pack of all my album mods. This catalogue will not do anything if my album mods aren't installed. It also won't do anything with the Alternative Textures versions of these mods.

Downloads.Description: 1.0.0 version. See mod description for more info.
